description: Worker killed mid-ingestion: document is recovered and reaches ready after the worker restarts
preconditions: Worker running as a local process
steps: Upload 6 large docs; SIGKILL worker; restart worker; poll
expected: All documents end ready (stalled job reclaimed); none stuck

description: Client disconnects mid-stream: the run lease is released and the thread can be used again
steps: Start /v1/agent/stream, abort after 2s; immediately send a new run on the same thread
expected: Follow-up eventually succeeds (200); not stuck busy forever
observations: 409 thread_busy while the abandoned run finishes is acceptable

description: Per-user concurrent run cap returns 429 too_many_concurrent_runs with Retry-After
steps: Fire 8 simultaneous invokes as one user
observations: 502/429 may come from the NVIDIA free tier under load

description: Database outage: readiness flips, API answers 503 with a stable error, then recovers without restart
steps: docker pause neuron-pg 12s; probe live/ready/list; unpause; probe again
expected: live stays 200; ready not 200 during outage; list 503 (never 500 stack/leak); all OK after recovery
